source.work: Python documentation, What's New in Python 3.15
source.paraphrase: The keyword form NamedTuple("Point", x=int, y=int) was removed in Python 3.15. Use a class or the fields list.

invariants.why: That keyword form no longer exists on Python 3.15. A project whose oldest supported Python is 3.15 or newer fails when the line runs.
invariants.fixHint: Use class Point(NamedTuple): x: int, or NamedTuple("Point", [("x", int)]).
invariants.avoid: Do not keep field names as keywords. A project that still supports a Python older than 3.15, or that declares no Python version, is not denied.

source.work: Python documentation, What's New in Python 3.15
source.paraphrase: TypedDict("TD") and TypedDict("TD", None) were removed in Python 3.15. Pass {} or use a class.

invariants.why: A TypedDict with no fields must say so explicitly. The omitted form and None were removed in Python 3.15.
invariants.fixHint: Write class TD(TypedDict): pass, or TypedDict("TD", {}).
invariants.avoid: Do not omit the fields argument or pass None. This stays silent when the oldest supported Python is older than 3.15.

source.work: Python documentation, What's New in Python 3.15
source.paraphrase: The sre_compile, sre_constants, and sre_parse modules were removed in Python 3.15. Use re.

invariants.why: Those three internal modules are gone in Python 3.15, so importing them raises ImportError on every interpreter this project still supports.
invariants.fixHint: Import re and call re.compile, re.escape, or the other public re functions.
invariants.avoid: Do not import sre_compile, sre_constants, or sre_parse, including through an alias or __import__. A project module of the same name is not the stdlib module. Older or undeclared targets are not denied.

source.work: Python documentation, What's New in Python 3.15
source.paraphrase: CGIHTTPRequestHandler was removed from http.server in Python 3.15. Use another request handler or an application server.

invariants.why: CGIHTTPRequestHandler and the http.server CGI mode were removed in Python 3.15. The process raises AttributeError or ImportError as soon as it reaches that name.
invariants.fixHint: Subclass BaseHTTPRequestHandler, or run the application on a WSGI or ASGI server.
invariants.avoid: Do not import or subclass CGIHTTPRequestHandler. The command-line --cgi flag is not visible in a Python file. Older or undeclared targets are not denied.

source.work: Python documentation, What's New in Python 3.15
source.paraphrase: typing.no_type_check_decorator was removed in Python 3.15. Use typing.no_type_check on one function instead.

invariants.why: no_type_check_decorator was removed in Python 3.15 after years with no type-checker support. Importing it raises ImportError.
invariants.fixHint: Delete the decorator. To skip one function, write typing.no_type_check(fn).
invariants.avoid: Do not import no_type_check_decorator under another name. typing.no_type_check on a single function is the supported call. Older or undeclared targets are not denied.

source.work: Python documentation, What's New in Python 3.15
source.paraphrase: The package parameter of importlib.resources.files was removed in Python 3.15. Use the anchor argument.

invariants.why: files() no longer accepts package=. Python 3.15 raises TypeError for that keyword.
invariants.avoid: Do not pass package=. A different function named files is not importlib.resources.files. Older or undeclared targets are not denied.

source.work: Python documentation, What's New in Python 3.15
source.paraphrase: code.co_lnotab was removed in Python 3.15. Use code.co_lines().

invariants.why: co_lnotab was removed from code objects in Python 3.15. Reading it raises AttributeError.
invariants.fixHint: Call code.co_lines() instead of reading co_lnotab.
invariants.avoid: Do not read co_lnotab through parentheses or another attribute chain. A string that mentions the name is not a read. Older or undeclared targets are not denied.

source.work: Python documentation, What's New in Python 3.15
source.paraphrase: asyncio.iscoroutinefunction is removed in Python 3.16. Use inspect.iscoroutinefunction.

invariants.why: asyncio.iscoroutinefunction is scheduled for removal in Python 3.16. inspect.iscoroutinefunction is the replacement and already exists.
invariants.avoid: Do not import asyncio.iscoroutinefunction under another name. A function you define yourself with that name is not the asyncio function. This denies only when the oldest supported Python is 3.16 or newer.

source.work: Python documentation, What's New in Python 3.15
source.paraphrase: The asyncio event-loop policy classes and get/set_event_loop_policy are removed in Python 3.16. Use asyncio.run or asyncio.Runner.

invariants.why: get_event_loop_policy, set_event_loop_policy, and the policy classes are scheduled for removal in Python 3.16.
invariants.fixHint: Call asyncio.run(main(), loop_factory=asyncio.SelectorEventLoop), or construct asyncio.Runner.
invariants.avoid: Do not call get_event_loop_policy or set_event_loop_policy, and do not name AbstractEventLoopPolicy, DefaultEventLoopPolicy, WindowsSelectorEventLoopPolicy, or WindowsProactorEventLoopPolicy. This denies only when the oldest supported Python is 3.16 or newer.

source.work: Python documentation, What's New in Python 3.15
source.paraphrase: ~True and ~False are removed in Python 3.16. Use not value, or ~int(value) for the integer bits.

invariants.why: Bitwise inversion of a bool is scheduled for removal in Python 3.16 because the result is an implementation surprise, not a logical not.
invariants.fixHint: Write not flag. For the integer bits, write ~int(flag).
invariants.avoid: Do not invert True or False, including inside parentheses. ~1 and ~int(flag) stay valid. This denies only when the oldest supported Python is 3.16 or newer.

source.work: Python documentation, What's New in Python 3.15
source.paraphrase: typing.ByteString and collections.abc.ByteString are removed in Python 3.17. Use Buffer or an explicit bytes union.

invariants.why: ByteString has no methods and does not include memoryview. It is scheduled for removal in Python 3.17.
invariants.fixHint: Annotate with collections.abc.Buffer, or with bytes | bytearray | memoryview.
invariants.avoid: Do not import ByteString from typing or collections.abc. A name you bind yourself is not that alias. This denies only when the oldest supported Python is 3.17 or newer.

source.work: Python documentation, What's New in Python 3.15
source.paraphrase: The profile module is removed in Python 3.17. Use profiling.tracing.

invariants.why: The profile module is scheduled for removal in Python 3.17. profiling.tracing is the replacement.
invariants.avoid: Do not import profile, including through an alias or importlib.import_module. cProfile and a project file named profile.py are not this module. This denies only when the oldest supported Python is 3.17 or newer.
